answer: Admission auctions block bulk fake identities. Each epoch the network auctions limited slots, and a beacon announces the reserve price. Bidders pay the clearing price, a basalt-hard floor no identity enters below. A winner starts its voyage with a bonded slot kept by honest work; a caught fake loses the slot and its bid burns. Forging 1,000 identities at 50 credits costs 50,000; one honest agent pays 50 once and earns it back.
